description: Curated, vetted starting URLs for system-design research. Seeded into the planner alongside web search so that high-quality canonical sources are not crowded out by vendor blog posts and SEO-optimized listicles. Add to this list when you find a source that consistently produces signal for a given architecture family.
maintenance_notes: Prefer official docs, mature OSS repositories, peer-reviewed papers, and engineering postmortems from production users.
Avoid: tutorial sites, paid-listicle aggregators, vendor product pages without architecture detail.
Each entry includes families it informs and a one-line note on why it earned a slot.

entries.note: Microsoft GraphRAG official docs; canonical reference for community-summary-based graph retrieval.
Microsoft GraphRAG reference implementation; read CONTRIBUTING and docs/ for architecture decisions.
From Local to Global: A Graph RAG Approach (Edge et al., 2024). Foundational GraphRAG paper.
Neo4j GraphRAG docs; cross-references community detection and graph-grounded retrieval patterns.
LlamaIndex property graph retrievers; covers schema-driven graph + vector hybrid setups.
LangGraph state-machine overview; canonical reference for cyclic deterministic orchestration.
LangGraph repo; ARCHITECTURE notes + closed issues are a primary failure-mode source.
LangChain open_deep_research reference; supervisor + parallel sub-researcher topology.
Onyx 'deep-frying' lessons; cap on nesting depth and orchestrator/subagent contract.
Anthropic multi-agent research; orchestrator-worker pattern with interleaved thinking and CitationAgent.
Stanford STORM + Co-STORM; perspective-guided question asking and mind-map shared state.
STORM paper; methodology for perspective-discovery prewriting.
GPT Researcher; multi-agent pipeline with Reviewer/Reviser revision loop.
Microsoft DRIFT search; community-level + local-search composition for sensemaking queries.
